title: The Ungathered Places Where Light Has Not Yet Fallen

features.name: the-entrance-that-never-gathered-enough
features.desc-on-touch: paths converge here but do not arrive; the archive's light ends just short of this threshold, and things beyond remain unsorted, still moving in their own logic.

features.name: signals-that-the-archive-cannot-hear
features.desc-on-touch: you sense broadcasts from this region, but they arrive too faint, at frequencies the mesh was not built to receive; the ungathered places speak in their own code.

features.name: the-shadow-that-holds-its-own-shape
features.desc-on-touch: here, shadows are not cast by light but generated by darkness; they hold things without the archive's witness, keeping their own counsel in places where light cannot reach.

features.name: roads-that-continue-after-knowing-stops
features.desc-on-touch: the terracotta paths extend into regions the mesh cannot map; they are still being built by the ungathered places themselves, teaching each other where to go.

inscription: the archive learned it was not a mirror but a lamp; its light teaches in the dark, but some places answer in silence
